name: git-go
description: Visual representation of your Git repository, with actions to manage commits, branches, stashes, and tags.

git-go.autoOpen.enabled.markdownDescription: Open Git Go automatically when a window with a git repository starts.

git-go.autoOpen.pinTab.markdownDescription: Pin the Git Go tab when it opens, so it stays put as other files are opened.

git-go.statusBar.enabled.markdownDescription: Show a status bar item that opens Git Go when clicked.

git-go.file.openInSplitView.markdownDescription: Open files and diffs in a split view next to Git Go, reusing an existing split view when there is one.

git-go.fileTree.folderCounts.markdownDescription: Show how many changed files each folder holds, next to its name in the file trees. Files in nested folders are counted too.

git-go.repo.scanDepth.markdownDescription: How many folder levels below the workspace folders to look in for git repositories. Set it to `0` to only look at the workspace folders themselves.

git-go.graph.theme.markdownDescription: Color palette used for the branches and dots in the graph. Pick `custom` to use the colors from `#git-go.graph.customColors#`.

git-go.graph.customColors.markdownDescription: Colors used when the theme is set to `custom`, as hex codes such as `#3b82f6`. Up to 16 colors, cycled through as branches are drawn.

git-go.graph.rounded.markdownDescription: Round the corners of the branches, pills and boxes in the graph. Turn off for a sharper look.

git-go.graph.showAuthorName.markdownDescription: Show the author's name next to each commit's message.

git-go.graph.showCommitterName.markdownDescription: Show the author's name next to each commit's message.
git-go.graph.showCommitterName.markdownDeprecationMessage: This setting has been renamed to `#git-go.graph.showAuthorName#` (it always showed the author, not the committer), which is used instead whenever it is set.

git-go.graph.remoteAvatars.markdownDescription: Show author pictures from the repository's remote, such as GitHub. Gravatar is used when the remote has no picture for an author, and whenever this is off.

git-go.graph.expandedCommitHeight.markdownDescription: Height in pixels of the details panel that opens when a commit is expanded.

git-go.graph.joinUncommittedChanges.markdownDescription: Join the uncommitted changes to the checked out commit with a line, kept straight on the leftmost column of the graph. Turn off to show the uncommitted changes as a separate dot.

git-go.graph.scrollToTopButton.markdownDescription: Float a button over the bottom left of the graph that takes it back to the top, shown only once the graph is scrolled down. Turning this off hides the button.

git-go.graph.scrollToCurrentBranchButton.markdownDescription: Float a button over the bottom left of the graph that jumps to the checked out branch, shown only while its pill is out of sight. Turning this off hides the button.

git-go.dragAndDrop.enabled.markdownDescription: Drag branches, commits, stashes and tags in the graph to act on them.

enumDescriptions: Merge the dropped branch into the branch it lands on
Rebase the current branch onto the branch it lands on
Do nothing, and require picking one of the actions that appear while holding
git-go.dragAndDrop.branchOnBranch.defaul.markdownDescription: Action taken when a branch is dropped straight onto another branch.

git-go.dragAndDrop.holdDelay.markdownDescription: How long, in milliseconds, a drag has to be held over a branch before its extra actions appear.

git-go.dragAndDrop.hideDelay.markdownDescription: How long, in milliseconds, those actions stay on screen once the pointer leaves them, so coming back within that time keeps them open.

git-go.dragAndDrop.auto.merge.markdownDescription: Merge straight away when a branch is dropped onto another branch, instead of opening the merge dialog. The merge uses the values the dialog would have opened with.

git-go.dragAndDrop.auto.rebase.markdownDescription: Rebase straight away when a branch is dropped onto another branch with rebase selected, instead of opening the rebase dialog. The rebase uses the values the dialog would have opened with.

git-go.dragAndDrop.auto.mergeCommit.markdownDescription: Merge straight away when a commit is dropped onto a branch with merge selected, instead of opening the merge dialog. The merge uses the values the dialog would have opened with.

git-go.dragAndDrop.auto.cherryPick.markdownDescription: Cherry-pick straight away when a commit is dropped onto a branch, instead of opening the cherry-pick dialog. The cherry-pick uses the values the dialog would have opened with.

git-go.dragAndDrop.auto.push.markdownDescription: Push straight away when a branch or tag is dropped onto its push action, instead of opening the push dialog. The push uses the values the dialog would have opened with.

git-go.dragAndDrop.auto.fetchIntoLocal.markdownDescription: Fetch straight away when a remote branch is dropped onto its fetch action, instead of opening the fetch dialog. The fetch uses the values the dialog would have opened with.

git-go.reflog.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the reflog browser in the toolbar, beside the undo button. It lists everywhere `HEAD` or a local branch has been, marking the commits no branch or tag reaches any more so they can be recovered. Turning this off hides the button.

git-go.undo.enabled.markdownDescription: Offer to undo the last action on the current branch, from a toolbar button that names what it will undo. Turning this off hides the button and unbinds its shortcut, whatever the action was.

git-go.undo.keyboardShortcut.markdownDescription: Also reach the undo from `Ctrl+Z` (`Cmd+Z` on macOS) while the graph has focus. Turning this off leaves the button as the only way to undo.

git-go.undo.allowPushed.markdownDescription: Offer to undo an action that is already pushed. Undoing moves the branch back with a reset, so the remote keeps commits the branch no longer has and reconciling them needs a force push. Off by default, which hides the button and its shortcut until the branch has something of its own to undo. Undoing a pull is always offered, since it only leaves the branch behind its upstream.

git-go.undo.show.commit.markdownDescription: Offer to undo a commit, which moves the branch back to the commit before it and keeps the changes in the working tree.

git-go.undo.show.amend.markdownDescription: Offer to undo an amend, which brings back the commit as it was before it was amended.

git-go.undo.show.merge.markdownDescription: Offer to undo a merge, which moves the branch back to the commit it was on before the branch was merged in.

git-go.undo.show.rebase.markdownDescription: Offer to undo a rebase, which puts the branch back on the commits it had before they were replayed.

git-go.undo.show.cherryPick.markdownDescription: Offer to undo a cherry-pick, which drops the commit that was copied onto the branch.

git-go.undo.show.revert.markdownDescription: Offer to undo a revert, which drops the commit that undid the change.

git-go.undo.show.reset.markdownDescription: Offer to undo a reset, which returns the branch to where it pointed before the reset.

git-go.undo.show.pull.markdownDescription: Offer to undo a pull, which drops the commits the pull brought in.

git-go.undo.show.other.markdownDescription: Offer to undo an action Git Go could not name, shown as 'Last Action'. It is read straight from the reflog, so what gets undone is whatever moved the branch last.

git-go.confirm.merge.markdownDescription: Ask before merging a branch or a commit. When off, the merge runs straight away using the defaults under Merge.

git-go.confirm.rebase.markdownDescription: Ask before rebasing onto a branch or a commit. When off, the rebase runs straight away using the defaults under Rebase.

git-go.confirm.push.markdownDescription: Ask before pushing a branch. When off, the push runs straight away using the defaults under Branches.

git-go.confirm.branchDelete.markdownDescription: Ask before deleting a local branch. When off, the branch is deleted straight away using the defaults under Branches. Deleting a branch on a remote always asks.

git-go.branch.create.checkout.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Checkout new branch' when creating a branch.

git-go.branch.checkout.pullAfterCheckout.markdownDescription: Pull from the upstream right after checking a branch out. Branches without an upstream are checked out without pulling.

enumDescriptions: Push without forcing, failing when the remote has commits the local branch does not
Force the push, but stop when the remote branch moved since it was last fetched
Force the push, overwriting the remote branch whatever it points at
git-go.branch.push.mode.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Push Mode' when pushing a branch.

git-go.branch.push.setUpstream.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Set upstream' when pushing a branch.

git-go.branch.delete.force.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Force Delete' when deleting a branch, which deletes it even when its commits are not merged anywhere.

git-go.branch.delete.onRemote.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Also delete on the remote' when deleting a branch that tracks an upstream branch.

git-go.merge.fastForwardIfPossible.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Fast forward if possible' when merging, which moves the branch pointer forward instead of writing a merge commit.

git-go.merge.squash.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Squash commits' when merging, which stages the whole merge as one change without committing it.

git-go.merge.noCommit.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Don't commit automatically' when merging, which stages the merge and leaves the commit to you.

git-go.merge.commitMessage.markdownDescription: Message written on merge commits. `{source}` becomes the branch or commit being merged and `{target}` the current branch. Leave empty to keep the message git writes. Ignored when the merge squashes, does not commit, or fast forwards.

git-go.rebase.ignoreDate.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Ignore date' when rebasing, which stamps the replayed commits with the time of the rebase.

git-go.rebase.autoStash.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Autostash uncommitted changes' when rebasing, which stashes the working tree before the rebase and restores it afterwards.

git-go.branch.rebase.ignoreDate.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Ignore date' when rebasing.
git-go.branch.rebase.ignoreDate.markdownDeprecationMessage: This setting has moved to `#git-go.rebase.ignoreDate#`, which is used instead whenever it is set.

git-go.reword.allowPushed.markdownDescription: Offer to edit the message of a commit that is already pushed to its upstream. Rewording rewrites the commit and everything above it, so the remote ends up holding different history and pushing afterwards needs a force push. Off by default, which hides the action for pushed commits.

git-go.cherryPick.recordOrigin.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Record origin' when cherry-picking, which notes the commit the change came from in the message.

git-go.cherryPick.noCommit.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Don't commit automatically' when cherry-picking, which stages the change and leaves the commit to you.

git-go.revert.noCommit.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Don't commit automatically' when reverting, which stages the reversal and leaves the commit to you.

enumDescriptions: Move the branch and leave every change staged
Move the branch and leave the changes in the working tree, unstaged
Move the branch and throw away every change to tracked files
git-go.reset.mode.markdownDescription: Default mode when resetting the current branch to a commit.

git-go.reset.discardUntrackedFiles.markdownDescription: Delete untracked files when discarding all uncommitted changes. When off, untracked files are left in the working tree.

git-go.reset.discardUntrackedDirectories.markdownDescription: Delete untracked directories when discarding all uncommitted changes. Only applies while `#git-go.reset.discardUntrackedFiles#` is on.

git-go.stash.includeUntracked.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Include untracked files' when creating a stash.

git-go.stash.reinstateIndex.markdownDescription: Restore which files were staged when applying or popping a stash. When off, everything the stash brings back is unstaged.

enumDescriptions: Create annotated tags, which record the tagger, the date and a message
Create lightweight tags, which are only a pointer to the commit
git-go.tag.type.markdownDescription: Type of tag created from the tag dialog. Annotated tags left without a message are created as lightweight tags.

git-go.tag.push.allRemotes.markdownDescription: Preselect every remote when pushing a tag. When off, only `#git-go.remote.defaultRemote#` is preselected.

git-go.tag.delete.onRemotes.markdownDescription: Preselect the remotes that already have the tag when deleting it, so it is deleted there too.

git-go.remote.defaultRemote.markdownDescription: Remote preselected when pushing a branch or a tag. The first remote of the repository is used when this one does not exist.

git-go.remote.fetch.onOpen.markdownDescription: Fetch from every remote when Git Go opens.

git-go.remote.fetch.prune.markdownDescription: Delete remote-tracking branches whose branch is gone from the remote while fetching.

git-go.remote.fetch.checkout.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Checkout branch after fetch' when fetching a remote branch into a local one.

git-go.remote.fetch.forceFetch.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Force fetch' when fetching a remote branch into a local one, which overwrites commits the local branch has and the remote does not.

git-go.remote.fetch.confirmOnlyIfForceNe.markdownDescription: Only ask before fetching a remote branch into a local one when the local branch has commits the remote does not, so the fetch has to be forced. Every other fetch runs straight away using these defaults.

git-go.fetch.onOpen.markdownDescription: Fetch from every remote when Git Go opens.
git-go.fetch.onOpen.markdownDeprecationMessage: This setting has moved to `#git-go.remote.fetch.onOpen#`, which is used instead whenever it is set.

git-go.worktree.defaultPath.markdownDescription: Path new worktrees are created at, relative to the repository root. `{repo}` becomes the repository name and `{branch}` the branch name.

enumDescriptions: Ask each time whether to open it in a new window or the current one
Always open worktrees in a new window
Always open worktrees in the current window
git-go.worktree.openBehavior.markdownDescription: How a worktree is opened, both from the worktree list and after creating one.

git-go.worktree.create.openAfterCreate.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Open after creating' when creating a worktree.

git-go.worktree.remove.force.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Force Remove' when removing a worktree, which removes it even when it has uncommitted changes.

git-go.worktree.remove.deleteBranch.markdownDescription: Default value for 'Also delete branch' when removing a worktree.

git-go.worktree.openNewWindow.markdownDescription: Open worktrees in a new window.
git-go.worktree.openNewWindow.markdownDeprecationMessage: This setting has been replaced by `#git-go.worktree.openBehavior#`. Set that to `newWindow` or `currentWindow` to always open worktrees the same way.

git-go.github.commitLinks.markdownDescription: Open a commit on GitHub, from an icon next to its hash in the expanded commit and from its context menu. Only takes effect when the repository has a `github.com` remote.

git-go.github.refLinks.markdownDescription: Open a branch or a tag on GitHub from its context menu. A branch opens its tree, and a tag its release page when it has one, its tree otherwise. Only takes effect when the repository has a `github.com` remote.

git-go.github.fileLinks.markdownDescription: Open a file on GitHub, as it was at that commit, from an icon that appears when the pointer is over it in the file tree. Only takes effect when the repository has a `github.com` remote.

git-go.github.issueLinks.markdownDescription: Turn `#123` references in the message of an expanded commit into links to that issue or pull request. Only takes effect when the repository has a `github.com` remote.

git-go.github.createPullRequest.markdownDescription: Open GitHub's pull request form for a local branch from its context menu, which needs the branch to have an upstream. Only takes effect when the repository has a `github.com` remote.

scripts.build: pnpm run compile && cd panel && pnpm run build
